---
title: Mozzarella and Olive Skewers
id: MAR-0074
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 20
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 300 g mozzarella
- 40 g pitted black olives
- 6 slices of sandwich bread
- 3 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Cut the mozzarella into cubes and let it drain in a colander.
2. Cut the sandwich bread into small squares and place them in a bowl.
3. Season them with oil and a pinch of salt.
4. Thread the ingredients onto skewers, alternating the bread cubes, mozzarella, and olives.
5. Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and broil for a few minutes.
